corpus_sweeps_on_share.note: collection is paused, so this total is final rather than a floor; geometry.json re-measured it at the end of its run and recorded zero drift

corpus_pairable_sweeps.note: sweeps captured by both radios, so a pair exists to import

corpus_single_radio_sweeps.note: the collector outage; adds to corpus_pairable_sweeps to give corpus_sweeps_on_share

corpus_freeze_low.note: the earliest freeze any figure in this report was computed on (cfo-cliff, f-strata, negative-control)

corpus_freeze_high.note: the widest freeze any figure in this report was computed on (arm-matrix, geometry)

corpus_scored_pairs.note: geometry is built on the widest freeze, corpus_freeze_high, so this is the paired count 'at the widest freeze'

corpus_matched_arm_cells.note: the population the published coincidence estimate rested on, with lnb-a excluded. The regenerated four-receiver figure in the same sidecar (/census/matched_arm_cells) stands at 36,384 over four receiver pairs; this census row describes the run the report published

corpus_live_target_observations.note: all four receivers; the matrix was regenerated with lnb-a restored

corpus_null_observations.note: fire-rate-problem is the figure behind the measured false-alarm rate and is one of the three-receiver figures inherited from the earlier freeze

corpus_lnba_observations_excluded.note: exactly the lnb-a observations the published correlation matrix omitted: /observations (all four receivers) minus /published_with_lnb_a_excluded/observations

corpus_lnba_own_edge_phi.note: unresidualised, so it is the raw own-edge agreement the sentence names

corpus_lnba_phi_ratio.note: the ratio the prose computes from the two phi values; recomputed on every build rather than typed

corpus_outage_from_utc.note: the last sweep pluto-5d4d contributed before the collector outage. No formatter renders a timestamp, so the sidecar's own compact UTC form is what the report prints

corpus_outage_to_utc.note: the first paired sweep after the outage; the pair of timestamps brackets the window in which pluto-5d4d produced nothing

corpus_last_scored.note: scoring runs in corpus order, so the last scored sidecar is where the scored corpus stops

corpus_threshold_redraw_max_delta.note: largest absolute movement of any of the six receiver pairs when lnb-a's cross-edge null arm is folded into the population the thresholds are drawn from
